## American Heart Association

American Heart Association:

Collaborated with stakeholders at AHA, Florida Agency for Health Care Administration,
and the University of Miami Health System on a policy brief centered around Florida
Medicaid reimbursements for the acquisition and use of Self Measured Blood Pressure
Devices for the management of hypertension
